idea-plugin.name: Install to Hubitat Hub
idea-plugin.description:
Install or update Hubitat Elevation apps and device drivers directly from the editor.

Open a Hubitat Groovy app or driver and click Install in the toolbar. The plugin uploads the file to your hub over your local network:

  • Updates an existing app or driver, looking up its ID on the hub by name and namespace
  • Installs a new app or driver if it doesn't exist on the hub yet
  • Detects whether the file is an app or a driver, and remembers your hub IP and choice per file
  • No changes to your code required. Optionally add // hub:, // type: and // id: comments to skip the prompts

This is an unofficial community plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hubitat, Inc. Source and docs: GitHub
